ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, Caterpillar’s consolidated net worth was $21.551 billion, which was above the $9.000 billion required covenant in the Credit Facility.

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial covenant interest coverage ratio
ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, Cat Financial’s covenant interest coverage ratio was 1.53 to 1. This was above the 1.15 to 1 minimum ratio

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial nine-month covenant leverage ratio
ratios.quote: In addition, at September 30, 2026, Cat Financial’s nine-month covenant leverage ratio was 8.01 to 1. This was below the maximum ratio of debt to net worth of 10 to 1

parsed.notes: Consolidated net worth covenant is a dollar amount in billions (not a ratio), reported for Caterpillar. Cat Financial's leverage covenant is debt to net worth (not debt/EBITDA), measured as a nine-month average of month-end ratios; classified as 'other'. Interest coverage covers Cat Financial (a consolidated subsidiary and co-borrower under the Credit Facility) on a trailing four-quarter basis.
